claim_boundary: This audit compares common-grid B1/B3 score V2 fields and separately reports annual projected-shadow boundaries. Legacy instantaneous warming and first/last frost phases are non-gating. It uses no observation values, holdouts or activity labels.

projection.phase_fields: lower median when at least half of subcells frost
projection.shadow_boundary: four-neighbor contrast of annual blocked-direct-energy fraction at least 0.1

normalization.scale_floor_role: lower bound on the reference scale

acceptance.shadow_boundary_role: reported diagnostic subset; not averaged into the global gate
